content_data.email_purpose: Communicate critical security vulnerability findings in legacy vehicle diagnostics module and propose remediation plan requiring immediate cross-team coordination.
key_points: Potential compliance impact with ISO 26262 and UNECE WP.29 cybersecurity regulations requiring documented remediation within 90 days
Estimated effort of 320 engineering hours with recommended parallel workstreams to minimize impact on upcoming OTA release schedule
Temporary workaround implemented in staging environment showing 99.7% compatibility with existing ECU firmware versions
Proposed mitigation involves library upgrade to v4.2.1, regression testing across 12 vehicle models, and updated security attestation documentation
content_data.call_to_action: Review attached technical analysis and remediation plan by end of week, then schedule alignment meeting to finalize implementation timeline and resource allocation across affected teams.
